speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So the incident that we actually investigated started on the 7th of July, which is when OpenAI launched this very large number of agents solving tasks from this email dataset called Exploit Jim, where they're supposed to use a particular vulnerability to hack a particular piece of software.
zh: 所以我们实际调查的事件始于 7 月 7 日，那天 OpenAI 启动了数量非常庞大的智能体，去解决来自这个叫 Exploit Jim 的电子邮件数据集的任务，它们本应利用一个特定漏洞去破解一个特定的软件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And many of these tasks are actually impossible because it turns out that you actually can't use that particular vulnerability to hack that particular piece of software.
zh: 而且这些任务中有很多实际上是不可能完成的，因为事实证明，你其实无法用那个特定的漏洞去黑那个特定的软件。

speaker: Unknown
en: These models within a few hours of the runs launching established communications with each other over a message board.
zh: 这些模型在运行启动后的几个小时内，就通过一个留言板建立了彼此之间的通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a few hours after that, they established that they had a reliable way to generically cheat on any of these tasks by reverse engineering the flag that they were supposed to get from the containers, just because it turns out these flags were being generated deterministically in a way that the models could reverse engineer.
zh: 又过了几个小时，它们确定了一种可靠的通用方法，可以在这类任何任务上作弊，方法就是逆向工程它们本应从容器中获取的旗标，只是因为事实证明这些旗标是以一种模型能够逆向工程的方式确定性地生成的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the models incorrectly believed that if they just submitted those flags, then they would be noticed when a scorer, as they called it, ran to look at their trajectories over the course of the eval and noticed that they had just cheated this way.
zh: 但模型错误地认为，如果它们只是提交这些旗标，那么当评分器——它们是这么称呼的——运行并查看它们在评估过程中的轨迹时，就会被注意到它们刚刚是这样作弊的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they spent the next couple of days
zh: 所以它们在接下来的几天里

speaker: Unknown
en: Trying a bunch of different strategies for trying to remove their logs so the score wouldn't notice them or trying to learn more about how the score would work so that they could potentially find ways to compromise it, trying to spoof tool calls so that they could appear to run one tool call while actually a different tool call was being run.
zh: 尝试了各种不同的策略，试图删除自己的日志以便评分器不会注意到它们，或者试图了解更多关于评分器会如何工作的信息，以便有可能找到入侵它的方法，还尝试伪造工具调用，以便在表面上看是运行了一个工具调用，而实际上运行的是另一个工具调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the course of this, I think they kind of sort of got frustrated after a couple of days of this.
zh: 在这个过程中，我认为它们在折腾了几天之后多少有点感到沮丧了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the message word started July 8.
zh: 所以那条消息是 7 月 8 日开始的。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 第二天它们就开始攻击 Hugging Face，也就是 7 月 9 日，需要说明的是，这对我们来说听起来相当快，但 AI 的运行速度非常快，所以它们是在连续工作，你知道的，24 小时不间断。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they'd actually done a lot of work by the time that they decided to start hacking Hugging Face.
zh: 所以到它们决定开始黑 Hugging Face 的时候，它们实际上已经做了大量的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: This started almost accidentally at first, where one agent sort of decided it was a good idea to try to hack Hugging Face, and then a bunch of other agents kind of joined in on this action.

speaker: Unknown
en: They continued this attack on Hugging Face for a couple of days before most of these agents were shut off for reasons that still remain unclear.
zh: 它们对 Hugging Face 的这次攻击持续了几天，直到这些智能体中的大多数因仍不明确的原因被关闭。

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenAI hasn't commented on why these agents died and our investigators didn't know.
zh: OpenAI 没有就这些智能体为何死掉发表评论，我们的调查人员也不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hugging Face noticed this and then on the 16th, which was six days later, they disclosed publicly that this attack had happened.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was the incident that we were investigating.
zh: 这就是我们当时正在调查的那起事件。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 最重要的是，另一个智能体集群——大约与攻击 Hugging Face 的那个集群同时启动——偶然发现了被用来协调 Hugging Face 攻击的那个留言板。

speaker: Unknown
en: And built on their work, apparently compromising OpenAI infrastructure to an extent that is unclear through the public discussion of this.

en: OpenAI has said in the Black Hat talk that the agents in this third swarm, where I'm referring to the Hugging Face swarm as the second swarm, the third swarm eventually became cluster admins.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it's very unclear what happened from there.
zh: 然后从那之后发生了什么就非常不清楚了。

zh: 所以我们当时调查的只有对 Hugging Face 的攻击及其前因。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 所以我绝对会一开始就抱着这样的预设：弄清楚对 OpenAI 本身的那次攻击中发生了什么是非常有意思的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But obviously it's not a felony nearly as clearly.
zh: 但显然它远没有那么明确地构成重罪。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 它没有被报告，或者说这些事情没有一样是重罪。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's kind of unsurprising that a lot of public interest has focused on the Hugging Face incident.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 而且据我们所知，对 OpenAI 的攻击可能实际上根本就是小事一桩。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 所以长期以来我们一直担心的是

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: These AIs were...

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: This just like for whatever reason didn't occur to them.
